title: fix(metadata-protocol): an object save or publish whose storage sync is refused says so on its answer
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DDUHyfgsW9WLX5BxP3bK55c)_

domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cyh75wtqD3bprL8aLT

Fixes #30635

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:保存对象(发布模式)和单项发布在建表/改表被数据源拒绝时,照旧答 200 成功,但答复的 `advisories` 里多一条 `warning`(规则 `object-storage-sync-refused`),写明哪个对象的存储没跟上、怎么修。
- 为什么改:实测 main(`47c457b2`):数据源拒绝同步时两个入口都答 200,答复里没有任何迹象,管理员要等读写失败才发现表没建;原因只在服务器日志里。
- 风险与回滚:只在同步被拒时加一条提示;状态码、其它键、发布结果都不变,同步正常时答复字节不变。数据源自带的拒绝原文只在它声明为 4xx 拒绝时才引用,否则提示「原因在服务器日志」,与同类 200 报告一致。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-registry-hydration.ts` 的 `objectStorageSyncRefusedNotice` 与 `ensureObjectStorage` 的 catch;`protocol-save.ts` 发布分支;`protocol-history-and-publish.ts` 的 `runPublishSideEffects`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.publish-side-effects-canonical-type.test.ts`,预期 12 passed(其中 #30635 六条)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`protocol-registry-hydration.ts`.** `ensureObjectStorage` now returns what it found: `undefined` when the sync ran (or the type has no storage), and one `RuntimeAuthoringIssue` when the driver refused it. The new exported `objectStorageSyncRefusedNotice(name, err)` builds it: `rule` `object-storage-sync-refused` (exported as `OBJECT_STORAGE_SYNC_REFUSED`), `severity` `warning`, `where` `object "NAME"`, `path` empty (the finding is about the item as a whole), a `message` naming the object and saying its storage was not created or altered, and a `hint` naming the two remedies the log line already names (publish again, or restart). The #22985 `error` line is unchanged, byte for byte, and still prints first.
- **The driver's text.** It is quoted on the advisory only when the driver declared a client refusal (a 4xx `status`), through `clientFacingFailureText`, the rule every side-effect report that rides a 2xx on these doors already follows (the materializer's `materializeApplied.error`, the batch's `failures[].error`). Any other failure says the reason is in the server log, where the `error` line carries it whole.
- **Save door** (`protocol-save.ts`, the `mode === 'publish'` branch): the advisory is appended to `saveNotices`, after the gate's findings and the save's own notices, so it rides the existing omitted-when-empty `advisories` key.
- **Publish door** (`protocol-history-and-publish.ts`): `runPublishSideEffects` returns it as `storageRefused`, and `publishMetaItem` appends it to the same omitted-when-empty `advisories`.
- **`protocol.ts`**: the two private pass-through signatures only (`ensureObjectStorage`'s return type, and one `storageRefused?` line on `runPublishSideEffects`' declared result). No body line.
- **`.changeset/30635-object-save-reports-refused-storage-sync.md`**: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` patch.

No new key on any response schema: `SaveMetaItemResponseSchema` and `PublishMetaItemResponseSchema` already declare `advisories` (`RuntimeAuthoringIssue[]`, `severity` `warning` or `info`, `rule` a free string), and the save already uses it for a non-gate fact about the write (`withheld-key-dropped`). The status code is unchanged and the publish is still not failed.

## Tests

`protocol.publish-side-effects-canonical-type.test.ts` gains a top-level `#30635` block in the file's existing harness (its stub engine already refuses a named object's sync, for #22985):

1. save door, refused sync: `success` and `state` `active`, exactly one `object-storage-sync-refused` warning with `path` empty and `where` `object "ticket"`; the undeclared driver text is not on it and the message points at the server log; the `error` line still carries the text.
2. save door, a declared (409) driver refusal: its text is quoted on the advisory.
3. CONTROL save door, clean sync: no `advisories` key at all.
4. CONTROL save door, draft save: no sync runs and no `advisories` key.
5. publish door, refused sync: `success`, exactly one warning, the declared text quoted.
6. CONTROL publish door, clean sync: no `advisories` key at all.

**Before (measured at `origin/main` `47c457b2`):** cases 1, 2 and 5 red (`expected undefined to match object`: a refused sync answered `success: true` with no `advisories` entry at all), the three controls green.

**After:** the file 12/12. Whole package on the final head `e01c8939`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test` 317 files passed, 4 skipped; 22460 tests passed, 26 skipped. `typecheck` exit 0.

**One more test file touched.** `protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts`'s engine double had no `syncObjectSchema`, so every publish in it ran a sync that threw (`syncObjectSchema is not a function`), which on `main` printed the #22985 `error` line unnoticed and now also adds the advisory; two of its pins assert "no advisories key" and went red. The double now has a sync that succeeds, so those pins read the gate's advisories alone. (The real engine always declares `syncObjectSchema`, `host-engine.ts`.) The `ensureObjectStorage` guard keeps its bare `return;`, which `protocol.object-registry-write-through-spelling.test.ts` counts in the source.

<details><summary>Ablations: each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, anchor 1 to 0, restored to the HEAD blob, git diff HEAD empty</summary>

| mutation | result |
|:---|:---|
| delete the save door's `saveNotices.push(storageRefused)` | cases 1 and 2 red, 10 green |
| delete the publish door's `response.advisories = [..., effects.storageRefused]` | case 5 red, 11 green |
| quote the raw driver text instead of `clientFacingFailureText` | case 1 red (the undeclared text reached the body), 11 green |

The test imports `./protocol.js` from source, so no `dist/` leg applies.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Not covered here, out of this card's file surface: the package-draft batch publish** (Studio's "publish whole app", `publishPackageDrafts`). It also runs the sync through `runPublishSideEffects`, and now receives `storageRefused`, but its body lives in `protocol.ts` (hot file, codemod in flight) and builds each `published[]` element before the side effects run, so reporting it there needs body edits. Until then that door reports a refused sync in the server log only, as before; the changeset says so. Handed to the seat.
- **Follow-up, spec lane:** the `advisories` describe in `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts` (save and publish response schemas) should name the new rule beside `withheld-key-dropped`.
- **Follow-up, ui:** showing this warning after a save in Studio/Setup is a separate card, as the issue says.
- **The data-loss refusal from #30632 (landed on `main` as `8d7f9065` while this PR was open) is withheld on the advisory as it stands:** `ExistingTableAdoptionRefusal` declares no `status`, so the advisory says the reason is in the server log rather than quoting its remedy text. If that prose should reach the caller, the driver declares it a client refusal (a 4xx `status`); that is the driver lane's call, not this PR's.
- **Deviation from the dispatch wording:** the dispatch said the message names the driver's refusal text. It does so only for a declared client refusal, by the existing withhold rule above; quoting every driver text would put raw driver failures on a 2xx body, which the rule exists to prevent.

## Verification

Local, on head `e01c8939` (merged with `origin/main` `b77c160a`):

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 60 families derived; `--ran`: 58 run, all exit 0; 2 NOT MEASURED (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`: exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET, they need a whole-tree build; CI runs them).
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`: exit 0; `typecheck`: exit 0.
- Re-run after the last commit: `check:engine-double-contract`, `check:durability-log-level`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`: exit 0.

Then `origin/main` `a2437b56` was merged (head `9c02a3e7`). It brings `objectql`, `driver-sql`, `rest` and `plugin-auth` commits and nothing under `packages/metadata-protocol`, none of which this package imports, so the local readings above were not re-run (AGENTS.md multi-agent §10, scoped re-check). Everything else is CI's.
